title: लिच्छविकालीन लंखोयाःया निरन्तरता लुभुया लःफोनेगु
nepali: लः जीवनय् मदय्क मगाः । जीवन न्ह्याकेत माःगु अन्नया नितिं नं लः हे माः । अथे खःसां प्राकृतिक रुपं वय्माःगु वा वइमखु । थुकिं यानाः छगूकथं जनजीवन हे अस्तव्यस्त जुजुं वनी । थुजोगु विकल्पहीन अवस्थाय् धार्मिक मूल्य मान्यताकथं द्योया आराधना पूजायात थाय् बी । नेपाःगालय् थुजोगु अवस्थाय् नेपाःगाः न्यंकर भुनाचोंगु गुँचोकाय् वनाः लः फों वनी । थथे लः फों वन कि वा वइ धाइ । थ्व पूर्व मध्यकालनिसेंया निरन्तरता खः । नेसं ४९७ य् हे नेपाः गालय् वा मवःगु इलय् खनेदुगु लः फोनेगु पद्धति थौंतकं ल्यंदनि । वा मवयाः समस्या जुल धाःसा थीथी गुँचोकाय् वनाः लः फोंवनी । उकीसनं लुभुया बीभुँती (विहेबर) लागाय् वनाः लः फोंवनी । थन वनाः लः फोंवनधाःसा वा वइ धइगु दु ।
american_english: Water is indispensable in life. Water is essential even for the food grain required to sustain life. Even so, the rain that should come naturally does not fall. Because of this, public life in a way becomes disrupted. In such a helpless state without alternatives, place is given to the worship and adoration of deities according to religious values and beliefs. In the Nepal Valley, under such conditions, people go to beg for water on the hilltops surrounding the Nepal Valley. It is said that when one goes to beg for water like this, rain will come. This is a continuation from the early medieval period. The practice of begging for water, seen in the Nepal Valley when rain did not come as early as Nepal Sambat 497, survives to this day. If problems arise due to drought, people go to various hilltops to beg for water. Among them, people go to beg for water in the Bibhunti (Bihebar) area of Lubhu. There is a belief that if one goes here to beg for water, rain will fall.
